name: India

fees.name: e-Tourist Visa (30 days, double entry)
fees.applies: most eligible nationalities (July-March rate; reduced to USD 10 April-June)
fees.notes: Country-specific fee schedule dated 20-Feb-2026. Some nationalities pay USD 0 (e.g. Argentina, Indonesia, Jamaica, Mauritius, Myanmar, Uruguay; Russia, Thailand, Malaysia, Philippines pay 0 for 30-day). Bank charge of 3% added to all e-visa fees.

fees.name: e-Tourist Visa (1 year, multiple entry)
fees.validity: 1 year, max 180 days stay per calendar year
fees.notes: Japan, Singapore, Sri Lanka pay USD 25; South Africa USD 25; several nationalities USD 0. Plus 3% bank charge.

fees.name: e-Tourist Visa (5 years, multiple entry)
fees.validity: 5 years, max 180 days stay per calendar year
fees.notes: USA USD 160; UK/Gibraltar/Jersey/Guernsey/Isle of Man USD 484; Russia USD 120; Japan/Sri Lanka/South Africa USD 25. Plus 3% bank charge.

fees.name: e-Business Visa (1 year, multiple entry)
fees.notes: Fee schedule dated 15-Apr-2026. Notable variations: USA USD 140, UK USD 242, Australia/Saudi Arabia USD 215, UAE USD 415, Philippines USD 220, Thailand USD 200, Japan USD 25; several nationalities USD 0. Plus 3% bank charge.

fees.name: e-Medical / e-Medical Attendant Visa
fees.notes: USA USD 100, UK USD 129, Russia USD 120, Bangladesh USD 0. Plus 3% bank charge.

fees.name: Visa on Arrival (Japan, South Korea, UAE nationals only)
fees.applies: Japanese, South Korean and UAE nationals only (UAE nationals must have held a prior Indian visa; Pakistan-origin UAE nationals excluded)
fees.notes: INR 2,000 or equivalent in foreign currency per passenger (including children). Available only at Bangalore, Chennai, Delhi, Hyderabad, Kolkata and Mumbai airports.

fees.name: Regular (sticker) Tourist Visa - embassy issued
fees.validity: varies by nationality (up to 10 years for US nationals)
fees.notes: Regular visa fees are set per nationality by reciprocity; no single global amount. Example (US nationals): Tourist 10-year USD 160. Plus ICWF USD 3 and outsourcing (VFS) service fee where applicable. See reciprocity_variations.

fees.name: Regular Business Visa - embassy issued
fees.validity: varies by nationality (10 years for US nationals)
fees.notes: Example (US nationals): Business 10-year USD 160. Reciprocity-based; verify at the Indian mission for each nationality.

fees.name: Transit Visa
fees.notes: Example (US nationals): USD 40. Reciprocity-based per nationality.

reciprocity_variations.note: Regular 10-year tourist visa; business 10-year also USD 160; transit USD 40; plus USD 3 ICWF + VFS service fee (Embassy of India Washington DC).
5-year e-Tourist USD 160 (vs standard 200); e-Business USD 140; e-Medical USD 100.
5-year e-Tourist USD 484; e-Business USD 242; e-Medical USD 129. 30-day/1-year e-Tourist standard (25/40).
30-day e-Tourist free; 1-year USD 40; 5-year USD 120; e-Business/e-Medical USD 120.
30-day e-Tourist free; 1-year USD 40; 5-year USD 200; e-Business USD 220.
Standard schedule: 30-day USD 25 (USD 10 Apr-Jun), 1-year USD 40, 5-year USD 200, e-Business USD 120.
Bangladesh: e-Medical/e-Medical Attendant USD 0; not eligible for e-Tourist/e-Business (regular visa regime applies, generally gratis for Bangladeshis per Indian High Commission Dhaka).
Pakistani nationals are not eligible for India e-visa or visa on arrival; regular visas under a restrictive bilateral regime, fee not published centrally.
China not listed on the Feb/Apr 2026 official e-visa fee schedules; Chinese nationals apply for regular visas via Indian missions (fee per mission schedule, not verified).
Nigeria not on the official e-Tourist fee schedule; Nigerian nationals use regular embassy visas (fee per Indian High Commission Abuja, not verified on an official page).

vfs.note: USD 19 per application at VFS Global centres in the USA, plus USD 3 ICWF; optional courier USD 18 and emergency processing USD 100. Service fees vary by country/centre (e.g. GBP-denominated in the UK).

free_visa_notes: Not free in general, but India grants gratis e-visas to a set of nationalities (Argentina, Cook Islands, Fiji, Indonesia, Jamaica, Kiribati, Marshall Is., Mauritius, Micronesia, Mongolia, Myanmar, Nauru, Niue, Palau, PNG, Samoa, Seychelles, Solomon Is., Tonga, Tuvalu, Uruguay, Vanuatu; and 30-day e-Tourist free for Russia, Thailand, Malaysia, Philippines). Nepal and Bhutan citizens need no visa for India.
